intent.en: Execute the criterion v2.2 attempt5 window signed at 2026-11-02T08:29:18+08:00: the 12:00 open attempt was manually stopped (external load, free 1747 MiB < signed floor 10376) and recorded; after the GPU was released at 13:14, re-sample three points (free 12947x3, util 4), run the regular monitor (-Required 60 -MaxMinutes 10, PS 5.1, MaxUtil=40, no -OpenUtilLimit) which passed (94 samples, longest_clean=60, util 1-64%, free_min 12435, exit 0; no exception), run the body (-Attempt 5 -GuardsFile ... -OutDir ...) with all 9 entities at exit 0 (body_wall 48.4 s), and post-window rechecks (outline_lists_post 2/2, post exe 9/9, zero_rust_compile, floor/increment not breached). Archive 33 evidence files under attempts/attempt5/ with a manifest, and commit the frozen guards (9e000bfc../37,000 B, aggregate 034c7551.., 94 entries) in the same commit so the freeze identity can be re-derived after target cleanup.
